trial_court: Court of MS Shilpi Singh, Erstwhile Judicial Magistrate-02 (South District), Saket Courts Complex, New Delhi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Rattan Kaur, represented through State of NCT of Delhi
parties.respondent_defendant: Mukesh Solanki s/o Sh. Mange Ram and Anil Katyal s/o Sh. KL Katyal

facts_of_case: Complainant Smt Rattan Kaur owns a land measuring 4,565 Sq yards at Village Adampur, District Gurgaon, Haryana. Accused no.1 approached her and asked her to sign on some papers in order to save the property from acquisition.

legal_principles.principle: Burden lies on the investigating officer to ensure that the investigation is fair and impartial.
legal_principles.held: He also admitted that he did not serve any notice on PW-4 or PW-6 even though he had 30 years of experience of investigation.

legal_principles.principle: A witness's credibility can be impeached by showing inconsistencies in their testimony.
legal_principles.held: During his cross examination by accused no.1, PW-8 admitted that in Ex PW-8/A, detail of number of seized documents or detail of attesting officer for point 1, 5 and 6 or date of execution or the cheque number, its date or branch at point 2, 3 and 4 was not mentioned.
